After applying on NATS/NAPS portal, candidates MUST also furnish required details including choice of 3 training locations through Microsoft Form at https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/5nNkU44Cuc latest by 12.12.2026.
Ensure all profile details (Caste, Educational background, Personal credentials, aggregate percentage) are correctly appearing in the application before submission.
Application window: 13th November 2026 (10:00 AM) to 12th December 2026 (5:00 PM).
Candidates applying for more than one discipline code will be summarily rejected. Apply for ANY ONE DISCIPLINE CODE ONLY.

title: Indian Bank Recruitment 2026 – Apprentice Posts
shortInfo: Indian Bank has announced notification for Apprentice posts. Required qualification: Graduate (Any Discipline). Last date to apply: 25-11-26.

dates.event: Opening Date for Online Registration & Payment of Application Fees
Closing Date for Online Registration & Payment of Application Fees

howToApply: Register on the NATS 2.0 Portal (www.nats.education.gov.in) before applying. Only candidates who passed graduation on or after 1st April 2022 need to register here. Ensure 100% complete profile on the portal.
Note down the Enrolment ID generated in NATS 2.0 Portal for future correspondence.
Visit the Bank’s website www.indianbank.bank.in and click on the Careers page or visit https://www.nats.education.gov.in and click on ‘Engagement of Apprentices in Indian Bank – 2026’.
Click on ‘Click here for New Registration’, enter Name, contact details and email ID. Note the Provisional Registration Number and Password generated.
Fill in the application form. Use ‘SAVE AND NEXT’ to save data if unable to complete in one go.

Upload scanned photograph (4.5cm x 3.5cm, 20KB–50KB), signature (black ink on white paper, 10KB–20KB), left thumb impression (20KB–50KB), and handwritten declaration (50KB–100KB) as per specifications in Annexure-II.
Preview and verify all details before clicking ‘COMPLETE REGISTRATION’.
Proceed to the ‘Payment’ tab and pay the application fee online using Debit/Credit Card or Internet Banking.
On successful payment, an e-Receipt will be generated. Take a printout of the e-Receipt and online application form for future reference.
Do NOT send the printout to the Bank.

title: Nagaland Police Recruitment 2026 – Constable (GD) Posts
shortInfo: Nagaland Police has announced notification for Constable (GD) posts. Required qualification: Class-6 Pass, Class-8 Pass. Last date to apply: 30-11-26.
howToApply: Visit the Nagaland Police Registration Portal at https://nagalandpolicerecruitment.in.
Fill in the Online Application Form with accurate details.

Upload self-attested photocopies of required documents: Educational Qualification certificates, Proof of Identity (Aadhaar/PAN/Driving License/EPIC), Indigenous Inhabitant Certificate, Scheduled Tribe/Backward Tribe Certificate, and Proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate/Matriculation Admit Card).
Pay the non-refundable examination fee of ₹300/- online.
Submit the application and download the Admit Card generated upon successful completion.
If applicable, provide details of the relevant Writ Petition (for Respondents/Petitioners covered by the High Court judgments).
